verdict.rationale: Vapi documents AI-driven testing: Voice Test Suites, where an AI tester calls the agent and follows a script of simulated customer behavior, and Evals, which validate mock conversations automatically before production. That covers automated AI review only for simulated calls. Nothing in the pack shows AI reviewing real production calls. Missing for 10: automatic post-call analysis of live calls, quality scoring, failure flagging, resolution/success analysis, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
